notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.content:
Update 1.07 

- added Spanish translation of the game
- Ukrainian translation edited
- Fixed the bug when entering an "empty" name - now each language shows a different name instead of the default "Красавчик"

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:

[*] Added the ability to view the final videos from the main menu  (if you got it)

[*] Music during credits is now played on the music channel

[/list]
